decisions.reason: The power-connector clause is already fully represented by the candidate's message-371 MODIFY; the signal-interface change requires no additional power-interface update.
The candidate's existing message-371 MODIFY already records both main-board input connectors, including the complete six-pin signal connector and pinout.
The specified connector pinout does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-ups, or series-resistor conditioning.
The source assigns named signals to an interboard connector but does not change their ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments.
The main-to-sensor signal connector carries I2C and UART signals and does not alter the native USB D+/D- programming interface.
Shared connector-family terminology is incidental; the source does not change the charge-status LED circuit or connector.
The SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C-mode requirement is already established by its message-371 INTRODUCE and needs no additional MODIFY.
The sensor-board signal connector does not affect the separate battery connector's family, pitch, pin count, functions, or unresolved pin order.
The interboard sensor-signal connector does not change the panel-mounted reset connector or its EN-to-GND behavior.
The source does not change the panel button or slide-switch connectors, GPIO assignments, or mounting arrangement.
The source's sensor-board connector matrix does not alter the separate PIR input connector requirement.
The signal-connector specification concerns the sensor board and does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting, orientation, clearance, or connector placement.
